aarti.tek: Victory to you, divine Dhanvantari; victory to you, revered Dhanvantari, O God. To everyone afflicted by old age and disease you are the giver of happiness.
aarti.pad1: You rose from the ocean bearing the pot of amṛta, and came and took away the troubles of the gods and the demons. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You made Āyurveda and spread it through the world; you taught the means of staying always in health. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Your four arms are most beautiful; you hold a conch and nectar. Āyurveda and the healing herbs give you great splendour. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Whoever meditates on you every day is not visited by disease; even his incurable disease is surely wiped away. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Lord, your servant stands with folded hands; the company of physicians gathers round your feet. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Whoever sings the āratī of Dhanvantari is not visited by disease or grief, and gains happiness and prosperity. ॥6॥
